items: Definition: A class within another class is called an inner class.
Definition: Anonymous inner classes are unnamed classes defined at the point of instantiation.
Usage: They provide a concise way to create objects that implement interfaces or extend classes without needing to define a separate class.

content.code: The grade for I1001 is B

items: Inner Classes: Useful for logical grouping and better encapsulation. They can access private members of the outer class.
Anonymous Inner Classes: Provide a compact way to instantiate classes for one-time use, either implementing interfaces or extending classes.
